name: San Carlos
shape: geoBoundaries, the department it is named for

climate: A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A wine area in Mendoza, with Cordón el Cepillo, La Consulta, Pampa el Cepillo and Paraje Altamira inside. Malbec dominates the plantings at 64%, followed by Cabernet Sauvignon and Tempranillo.
